Actor Prakash Raj visited Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit in Kalady and expressed support for students who have been on a hunger strike after being suspended and denied permission to write examinations.
Criticising the Kerala government and Higher Education Minister Roji M John, Raj described the actions against the students as “dictatorial” and questioned the handling of the issue. He urged authorities to allow the students to appear for their examinations and warned that he would join the hunger strike if the dispute remains unresolved.
